Correction. The maintainer asked for a GUI test before any push of this work. No GUI test has happened yet, and no comment on this PR should claim one. (An earlier comment that claimed it was deleted; it also carried the ready flag, which was withdrawn, so the PR is a draft again.)

The PR is up because the branch and the draft PR are the work record. Nothing merges until the maintainer tests the build and the independent review is clean.

Reproducible readings on head 984b2af6: camcraft-ui lib suite 793 passed, report_tests 7, structural 10, op_icon_table 5, clippy 0 warnings, `cargo xtask icons --check` 0 breaches.

Test build: `.claude/worktrees/issue-1696/target/debug/camcraft-ui.exe`

Note for the reviewer: this PR touches `.github/`, so `pr-test.yml` refuses it and the review builds locally (read, not built: the yellow `needs-maintainer` path).

This comment gives the decision that the maintainer made for issue #1696 after this PR was opened. It changes no label and no state of this PR.

The decision (2026-11-17, issue #1696): "GitHub issue in browser".
- Send opens a new GitHub issue of this repository in the browser. The type, the title, the description and the program version are filled in.
- The program uploads nothing. It saves the screenshot and the log to a folder, opens that folder, and tells the user to drag the files into the issue.
- The project file is included only when the user sets the check box. The program then copies it to the same folder and does not upload it.
- The program stores no account data.

What this PR has, as an agent read it: a Report door beside Debug info, "Report a bug" and "Request a feature" with a prefilled issue URL, "Copy screenshot" to the clipboard, and the Debug info report in the body. This agrees with the first point of the decision.

What the agent did not find in this PR:
- The type selection Bug, Feature, Question.
- A description field.
- The check box for the project file.
- The check box for the log.
- A screenshot preview with "Retake screenshot".
- The step that saves the files to a folder and opens that folder.

If one of these items is in the PR, tell us and we correct this list. Your claim on #1696 stays live while this PR is open. No agent of this repository works #1696 during that time.

Thank you for this pull request.

The pull request stays with you. The maintainers do not change your branch.

Review 5954356955 found three items to correct. Please correct them before the maintainer decides on the pull request.

1. `.github/config.yml` has no effect. GitHub reads `blank_issues_enabled` from `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`. Move the setting to that file.

2. The pull request body and the `Changelog:` row describe an earlier design: a raster of the document. The code copies a screenshot of the whole window. Update the body and the row to say what the code does.

3. `assets/ui/svg/act-report.svg` follows the shape of the Tabler banner icon. The provenance line says "original". Correct that line. Name Tabler Icons (MIT) as the source, as `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` requires.

When the three items are corrected, write a comment on this pull request. A new review then runs on the new head. The maintainer merges outside pull requests by hand.

Back to draft for the three corrections in the 2026-11-18 review comment. 1. I move the blank-issue setting to `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`. 2. I update the body and the `Changelog:` row to say the code copies a screenshot of the whole window. 3. I correct the provenance of `assets/ui/svg/act-report.svg`: it comes from the Tabler Icons (MIT)  anner glyph. I will flag the pull request ready again after the gate is green.

Ready for a re-check on the new head (2c2b227).

The three review items are fixed in a30e58343:

Then I merged origin/main (4cab68f, class DELTA). One easy conflict, both sides added lines: `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`. I kept main's heart.svg lines and my act-report lines together. No logic hunk was resolved by hand.

Quick gate, green: all 17 ui steps, including `ui suites: lib`. Pinning tests: the 10 `report_tests` (`the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`, `a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`, `the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`, `the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`, `an_answer_for_another_token_is_left_alone`, `no_answer_copies_nothing`, `the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`, `the_url_prefills_the_new_issue_with_title_body_and_label`, `the_body_carries_the_questions_and_the_debug_report`, `url_encode_keeps_safe_words_and_plains_the_rest`) and `report::tests::the_shot_token_matches_only_itself`. The maintainer GUI-tested the whole-window capture on the prior head and said it looks good.

Note: on the old base, `ui suites: lib` crashed with an access violation at 6 test threads. The crash did not reproduce after this merge, so a fix in the gap covers it.

Back to draft for one wording fix. The review of head 2c2b227 asked for it: `docs/decisions/1696-report-button.md` still described the old design (`template=blank-issue.md` URL, document-only shot). I fix those sentences to match the shipped code (plain `issues/new?title=..&body=..&labels=..` and the whole-window shot). Docs only, no code.

Wording fix pushed as 40d9678. The decision file now matches the shipped code: the plain `issues/new?title=..&body=..&labels=..` URL and the whole-window screenshot. Docs only, no code. Gate: the ui lib suite first crashed at `--test-threads=6` with STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION (intermittent, not from this change); a full re-run passed at 4 and 8 threads, 1159 tests. All other ui suites green. ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 40d967840026f5cf2193d2d68537efcc4895bcae -->

Reviewed PR #1798 at head 40d967840026f5cf2193d2d68537efcc4895bcae. The trial merge with main was clean. Built locally: camcraft-ui lib 1245 passed / 0 failed (includes the new report tests and the structural pin), egui_app binary 8 passed, clippy clean (-D warnings).

**What the UI sends to GitHub.** Nothing leaves the machine without a button press. The user clicks "Report a bug" or "Request a feature". The app then (1) opens the fixed URL https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/new in a browser tab with the title, body and label in the query, and (2) puts a picture of the app's own window on the clipboard. The diff contains no network code. The picture is egui's window re-render, not an OS screen capture.

**Findings for the maintainer.**
1. Privacy. The body embeds the Debug info report (#157). Its "Project:" line is the full file path of the project on the user's disk, and that path usually holds the user name. The browser sends it to github.com in the URL. Consider sending the file name only, not the path.
2. Small gap. If the read-back map fails (a lost device), the capture callback drops the waiting tokens and leaves in_flight false. The timeout in due() then cannot fire, and the status stays at "copying the whole window". The failure is rare and the text report still works. A status line would close it.
3. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Our own UI PRs must have them.

**Law checks.** Files under 400 lines. The act-report glyph is Tabler's "banner" (MIT); LICENSES.md records it. Window state is view state, not a command - correct for an open/close door. Tests pin the token gate, the late answer, and the foreign-token refusal.

Verdict: **needs-maintainer** (label unchanged). The PR edits .github/ files, and the owner must decide that. No code blocker found.

Merge class: SAME. The head is `40d967840026f5cf2193d2d68537efcc4895bcae`, the head that the review of 09:01 UTC names (comment 7004545700). No commit came after that review. The PR merges cleanly with `main`. This merge relies on that review.

The maintainer read the three findings of that review and ordered the merge as it is (2026-11-19, relayed by the main session). He waived the before and after screenshots for this PR. That decision removes the `needs-maintainer` hold. Follow-up issues record the three findings.
